entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `imagePaths` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAtEpochMillis` INTEGER NOT NULL, `pageCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `text` TEXT NOT NULL, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `merchant` TEXT, `date` TEXT, `total` TEXT, `insightSource` TEXT NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_documents_imagePaths
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_documents_imagePaths` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`imagePaths`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`documents`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_documents_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `documents` BEGIN DELETE FROM `documents_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_documents_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `documents` BEGIN DELETE FROM `documents_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_documents_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `documents` BEGIN INSERT INTO `documents_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_documents_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `documents` BEGIN INSERT INTO `documents_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
